svg.aria-label: A Ghostty terminal running herdr with Catppuccin Mocha. Left pane: Neovim editing aziz.lua, a profile written as a Lua table: Abduaziz Umarov, UCF Computer Science May 2028, SWE Intern at Versant Media on Rotten Tomatoes, builds backend systems and applied AI, open to Summer 2027 SWE internships. Right pane: a zsh session types ls ~/projects, cat wins.txt (CrisisLens 1st in the Databricks Challenge at Hacklytics 2026, Farsight 4 sponsor tracks at Knight Hacks IX, Backrooms Hyphenate track prize at Cal Hacks 13.0), gh pr list for 3 merged badges/shields PRs, and tree of the dotfiles repo.
